qa_checks.cards: family readable vs ref thumbnail; silhouette; alpha + real transparency, no crop, extent 0.70-0.85(+); QA-4 dark families brightness >= 0.25 (Rec.709 luma and HSV V on alpha>128 pixels), full-albo interior saturation < 0.10; 2D hand-drawn/low-poly, no text/border/shadow; set uniformity per style; 96px grade readability
qa_checks.species: one leaf, petiole down, whole leaf, white background (border white fraction), pastel low-poly like PP/AL; species traits; whole-plant habit (vine / rosette)
qa_checks.stage: same framing across five, stages distinct, same line/colour as ev_first_varie_halfmoon, no pot/characters/text, 1:1 (strip 16:9)

set_notes: Cards: each style reads as one set (same angle, size ~80-90% of frame, same line weight / facet look).

Cards: petiole placement is inconsistent across the set - the family ref thumbnails show the petiole at the top notch, the prompt asks for it pointing down; style A mostly draws a short stem below the leaf tip (notch at top), some cards (P1_a, several style-B cards e.g. charcoal B_a, pp_* B) keep it at the top notch. Origin is the ref/prompt conflict in the order, not a generation fault.

Cards at 96px: every family stays distinguishable; galaxy_tealgold/galaxy_darkteal (half-moon grade) and variegata_gold (full-moon grade) do not visually signal their grade - a family-design property, not a generation failure.
QA-4 brightness measured two ways on leaf pixels (alpha>128): Rec.709 luma of sRGB values and HSV V (leaf tools' 밝기). Both reported per image.

No line had both variants fail categorically (wrong plant / pattern ignored / no transparency), so no _c/_d retries were run. The QA-4 dark-family misses are systematic (a/b spread <= 0.012), so a same-prompt re-roll would not fix them; a prompt tweak (lighter base) or a brightness lift in post is the lever.
